sentences.japanese: 教授は私の研究を励ましてくれた。
sentences.english: The professor encouraged me in my studies.

sentences.japanese: 彼は休養するどころか、かえっていつもより仕事に励んだ。
sentences.english: Instead of taking a rest, he worked much harder than usual.

sentences.japanese: 宇宙飛行士達は熱狂した人々の励ましと喝采に迎えられた。
sentences.english: The astronauts were greeted with cheers and applause of an enthusiastic crowd.

sentences.japanese: もう一度やってみるようにと彼を励ましなさい。
sentences.english: You must encourage him to try again.

sentences.japanese: みんなそれぞれ自分の仕事に励んでいた。
sentences.english: Everybody was going about his business.
